meta.name: review
meta.description: Review a proposed customer code change against its intended outcome and operational risks. Use for a diff or PR review; report evidence and actionable findings.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照预期目标与运行风险审读代码改动,给出有证据、可落地的审查结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次有人提交代码改动,都需要先弄清它是否达到预期、会不会带来运行风险
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every incoming diff needs a risk-and-intent check before it ships

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审查一份拟提交的客户代码改动，把它和改动想达到的结果、以及运行风险对照起来，输出带证据、可执行的发现报告。
howto.when: 当你要审查一段 diff 或一个 PR 时触发；若由 @fde 调用，会复用它当前的脱敏数据包与范围，不重启设置或重复提问。

say.text: 帮我审查这个 PR，对照它想达到的结果给出证据。
say.note: 输出带证据的发现报告。

say.text: 这段 diff 有哪些运行风险？只列有证据的问题。
用 @fde 当前的范围审查这次改动。
say.note: 复用已脱敏的数据包，不重新设置。

howto.what_en: Installs a review workflow: it checks a proposed customer code change against its intended outcome and operational risks, then reports evidence and actionable findings from the supplied context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a diff or PR review. If @fde calls it, it reuses that run's sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or questions.

say_en.text: Review this PR against its intended outcome and give evidence.
say_en.note: Produces a findings report with evidence.

say_en.text: What operational risks does this diff carry? Evidence only.
Review this change within @fde's current scope.
